verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲਾ ਧਉਲਾ ਰਤੜਾ ਨੀਲਾ ਪੀਲਾ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਾਜੇ।
verses.translit_en: kaalaa dhaulaa rataRaa neelaa peelaa hariaa saaje|

en.bdb: Black, white, red, blue, yellow and green colours are adorning (the creation).

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸੁ ਕਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਸਾਦੁ ਜੀਭਹੁਂ ਜਾਪ ਨ ਖਾਜ ਅਖਾਜੇ।
verses.translit_en: ras kas kar visamaadh saadh jeebhahu(n) jaap na khaaj akhaaje|

en.bdb: Wondrous tastes of edible and inedible objects have been made which are known through the tongue.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਉੜਾ ਖਟੁ ਤੁਰਸੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਸਾਉ ਸਲੂਣਾ ਛਾਜੇ।
verses.translit_en: miThaa kauRaa khaT turas fikaa saau saloonaa chhaaje|

en.bdb: These tastes are sweet, bitter, sour, salty and insipid.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਅਵੇਸ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਕੇਸਰੁ ਕਾਜੇ।
verses.translit_en: ga(n)dh suga(n)dh aves kar choaa cha(n)dhan kesar kaaje|

en.bdb: Mixing many fragrances, the camphor, sandal and saffron have been created.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਦੁ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਪਾਨ ਫੁਲੁ ਅੰਬਰੁ ਚੂਰ ਕਪੂਰ ਅੰਦਾਜੇ।
verses.translit_en: medh kathooree paan ful a(n)bar choor kapoor a(n)dhaaje|

en.bdb: Others such as musk cat, musk, betel, flowers, incense, camphors etc are also held to be similar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸੰਬਾਦ ਬਹੁ ਚਉਦਹ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਅਨਹਦ ਗਾਜੇ।
verses.translit_en: raag naadh sa(n)baadh bahu chaudheh vidhiaa anahadh gaaje|

en.bdb: Many are the musical measures, vibrations and dialogues, and through fourteen skills the unstruck melody rings.
Lacs of rivers are there on which crores of ships ply.
